name: Longines
desc: Swiss watch brand founded in Saint-Imier, owned by the Swatch Group since 1983 and long known for equestrian and sports timekeeping.

name: Festina
desc: Spanish watch group owned by Miguel Rodríguez, owning Festina, Lotus, Candino, Jaguar, Perrelet, Kronaby and movement-maker Soprod.

name: Bob Jane T-Marts
desc: Family-run Melbourne tyre and car service retailer founded by racing driver Bob Jane in 1965, with over 100 franchises in Australia.

name: WAGO
desc: Family-owned German maker of spring-pressure terminal blocks, connectors and automation components, a world leader in spring-clamp connection technology.

name: Rabobank
desc: Dutch cooperative bank federation specialising in food and agribusiness finance, with offices in 38 countries and long-standing sports sponsorships.

name: Horsch
desc: German family-run maker of soil cultivation, seeding and crop protection machinery founded by farmer Michael Horsch.

name: Fercam
desc: Family-run Italian transport and logistics group with 93 branches across Europe and North Africa and a 4,300-vehicle fleet.

name: Metacore
desc: Finnish mobile game developer of Merge Mansion, majority-owned and funded by Supercell, with offices in Helsinki and Berlin.

name: TÜV SÜD
desc: German testing, inspection and certification group with 25,000+ staff and 1,000+ locations across Europe, the Americas and Asia.

name: Theory
desc: New York contemporary fashion brand for men and women with hundreds of stores worldwide, wholly owned by Fast Retailing.

name: Zollner Elektronik
desc: Family-owned German contract electronics manufacturer with plants in Germany, Hungary, Romania, China, Tunisia, the US, Switzerland and Costa Rica.

name: Desigual

name: 4flow

name: IAV
desc: Berlin automotive engineering company developing powertrain, electronics, software and complete vehicles for carmakers and suppliers, with sites in nine countries.

name: BlaBlaCar

name: Edelman
desc: Family-owned global public relations and communications firm, the largest PR agency by fee income, with about 6,000 staff in 60 offices.

name: TradingView
desc: Financial charting, market-data and social trading platform used by retail traders and brokers, with offices in New York, London, Málaga and Tbilisi.

name: WestJet
desc: Calgary-based Canadian airline with 169 Boeing aircraft and 104 destinations, owned by Onex with minority stakes held by Delta and Korean Air.

name: Sapiens
desc: Insurance software company providing policy, billing, claims and data platforms to life, property and casualty insurers worldwide.

name: Honor
desc: Shenzhen smartphone, tablet and laptop maker spun out of Huawei in 2020, majority-held by a Shenzhen state-linked consortium and preparing an IPO.

name: Insight Partners
desc: Venture capital and growth equity firm investing in high-growth software and internet companies, managing about USD 90 billion.

name: Air India
desc: Indian flag carrier owned by Tata Group and Singapore Airlines, operating 189 aircraft to 87 destinations after absorbing Vistara.

name: First Eagle Investments
desc: New York investment manager known for global value funds and alternative credit, majority-owned by Genstar Capital since 2025.

name: dalli group (Dalli-Werke)
desc: Sixth-generation Wirtz family manufacturer of laundry, cleaning and personal-care products, own brands and retailer private labels, with five plants.

name: Scientific Games (lottery)
desc: Supplier of instant lottery games, lottery systems, licensed-brand games and retail and digital lottery technology to government lotteries worldwide.

name: Reliance Retail
desc: India's largest retailer, running grocery, electronics, fashion, jewellery and online formats through more than 18,000 stores and AJIO and JioMart.

name: Lawson

name: SCHOTT AG
desc: Foundation-owned German maker of specialty glass, glass-ceramics and polymers for appliances, pharma, semiconductors, optics, automotive and aerospace.

name: Grupo Dreamers
desc: Brazilian live entertainment group of 18 companies producing Rock in Rio, Rock in Rio Lisboa, The Town and Lollapalooza.

name: Werner & Mertz

name: Momentive Performance Materials

name: Whyte & Mackay

name: Protective Life

name: Chevron Phillips Chemical Company

name: BNP Paribas Cardif
desc: Insurance subsidiary of BNP Paribas selling savings and protection products through more than 500 distribution partners in 30 countries.

name: Argon 18
desc: Montreal maker of road, triathlon and track bicycles founded in 1989, distributed in more than 70 countries and supplying pro teams.

name: Merbag
desc: Family-owned Swiss Mercedes-Benz dealer group with 64 sites across Switzerland, Germany, Austria, Italy and Luxembourg.

name: Putzmeister
desc: German maker of truck-mounted concrete pumps, mortar machines and industrial pumps, owned by Chinese construction-machinery group Sany since 2012.

name: ALTRAD
desc: French industrial-services and scaffolding group led by founder-chairman Mohed Altrad, employing 65,000 people in more than 50 countries.

name: Dr. Willmar Schwabe
desc: Family-run German maker of plant-based medicines such as Tebonin and Umckaloabo, homeopathics (DHU) and US supplements (Nature's Way).
